instruction.text: Find and select the bottle to learn about babies.

feedback.end: Everyone starts life as a baby. Babies need a lot of care. For example, babies need to be fed and carried everywhere they go, since they cannot walk.

instruction.text: Find and select the book to learn about toddlers.

feedback.end: Toddlers are a bit older than babies. They are between one and three years old. Toddlers are usually just beginning to learn how to walk and talk.

instruction.text: Find and select the red jug to learn about children.

feedback.end: Children are older than babies and toddlers. Unlike babies, children are able to feed themselves, run around and do all sorts of other things. But children still need adults to take care of them and make sure they get what they need.

instruction.text: Find and select the yellow headphones to learn about teenagers.

feedback.end: When children get older, they become teenagers. This means they are between 13 and 19 years old. Most teenagers still live with their parents but also start to learn to take care of themselves during this time.

instruction.text: Which adult here do you think is older? Select the correct picture.

feedback.end: That’s correct! When an adult gets older, usually about 70, they are called elderly, or a pensioner.
